documentation.content:
A FairWins origin (bundler or gateway VM) is failing its functional uptime check.

The bundler check matches 0x5FF137D4 from eth_supportedEntryPoints; the gateway check matches "rpc":"up" from /status. Neither is a plain 200, so a failure means the service is functionally dead, not merely slow.

Impact: gasless relaying degrades to self-submit (members pay their own gas). Passkey accountNative ops have NO fallback rail and will fail outright if the bundler is down.

Runbook: docs/runbooks/vm-migration.md
